question: Where are Elapura, Kuddyakesi and the rest?
premises: from right thigh-hip, wall-haired Kuddyakesi and staircase
inference: Pitha-list continues across body and sacred geography.
plain_english: Elapura at the east bank; from right thigh and hip, wall-haired Kuddyakesi and staircase; likewise in Mayapu-Ksiraka.
